dataset_note: Transformer Based Financial News Scores (category=other, delay=1, universe=MINVOL1M). Daily sentiment/relevance scores for Dow Jones Newswires stories via a custom transformer NLP model. 105 MATRIX fields = 7 aggregation families (average/median/maximum/minimum/stddev/lower_confidence/upper_confidence) x {negative, neutral, positive} polarity x NLP variants 1-6. All fields share coverage 0.4621 (fraction of MINVOL1M names with >=1 mapped story that day) and very low alphaCount (1-24) => blue-ocean. Domain [0,1] polarity. Daily update frequency. | 2026-11-01 注入 companion 总量字段: assets_total_2(fundamental23, cov=0.9603), fnd23_tot_revenue(fundamental23, cov=0.9117) — 仅作 Iron Law A 分母，非主信号源 | [AEGIS-授权] 已注入 1 个 GLB fundamental23 跨数据集归一锚 fnd23_tot_assets (cov=0.9601, HOT), 仅供分母/差分基准, 满足铁律 A 高覆盖归一锚要求。
